title: Markup dictionary
subject: ui
summary: Every value a node may carry: the elements per family with their axes, the typography identities, the layout regions, the axis values. Generated.

axioms.text: The dictionary is generated from the table of primitives and never written by hand.
A value that is not in the dictionary is not valid markup.

purpose.intro: Markup and theme meet on a finite vocabulary. Listing it in one generated place means a component, a theme and a checker read the same list, and a typo is an error, not a silent miss.

reference.statement: Format: `element="{family}--{element}"`. Generated from `shared/libs/ui/types/elements.ts` by `shared/libs/ui/scripts/markup-dictionary-elements.ts`. Each row lists the axes the element carries: `all` is the full set from `types/axes.ts`, `–` means the axis does not apply, anything else is the subset. `concept` is always allowed. Typography identities (`type--…`) are a separate vocabulary.

reference.statement: Transient states (`hover`, `active`, `focus`) are CSS pseudo-classes only — never set as attributes.
Default when absent: `md`. Affects padding, typography, icon size. Never colors.
Values are product-defined: `"knowledge"`, `"dashboard"`, `"settings"`, etc. Set on a wrapper element — descendants inherit the visual overrides.
